verdict.rationale: Hightouch docs describe a native 'built-in agent' in the product for exploring segments and analyzing campaign performance in natural language (hightouch-docs-19), which supports delegating tasks to an in-product AI assistant. However, most AI-assistant detail in the evidence pack (hightouch-docs-10/11/12/31/55/56) actually describes the MCP server, which connects external AI assistants to Hightouch rather than a fully-fledged in-app assistant handling broad task delegation, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the built-in agent's capabilities. Missing for 10: independent verification of the built-in agent, broader scope of tasks it can perform beyond segment/campaign analysis, and UI/product screenshots or reviews demonstrating it in use.
